source_analysis.reusable_architecture: Describe an ambitious creation shaped by practical and aesthetic goals, explain the design features that made it notable, identify deterioration or obsolescence, trace a careful restoration or adaptation, and conclude by linking the renewed work to its original purpose.

blueprints.new_topic_domain: Restoring a nineteenth-century wrought-iron palm house while protecting its living collection
blueprints.rhetorical_arc: Introduce the challenge of enclosing tropical plants; explain the curved iron-and-glass design; trace corrosion and climate-control problems; describe numbered disassembly and repair; conclude with preserved architecture serving living plants.

blueprints.new_topic_domain: Reconstructing a silent film from incomplete prints held by several archives
blueprints.rhetorical_arc: Introduce loss and decay in early film; explain how different prints preserve different material; compare and scan surviving frames; reconstruct sequence and intertitles with documented uncertainty; conclude with a viewable film that retains evidence of its fragmented survival.
